metaTitle: Custom Direct to Garment Headwear | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom direct to garment headwear for your team. Full-color DTG printing on hats. Perfect for events and uniforms. Bulk pricing available.
introHtml: Direct-to-garment printing on headwear lets you reproduce complex logos, gradients, and photographic images with remarkable detail and soft hand feel. Unlike traditional embroidery or screen printing, DTG applies ink directly into the fabric fibers, creating a breathable, lightweight decoration that won't crack or peel. This method works especially well for caps made from 100% cotton or cotton-poly blends, making it a smart choice for event staff uniforms, trade show giveaways, or branded merchandise where full-color artwork is essential.
heroAltText: Custom direct to garment headwear with full-color logo printed on cotton twill cap
